store.name: Daily Journal – Private Diary
store.subtitle: Write privately, with photos
store.promotionalText: Your private journal with photos, writing prompts and a mood history – no account, no cloud. Your entries stay on your device.
store.description:
Your private journal – as lovely as a paper notebook, safe on your phone.

Capture what moves you: a few lines in the evening, a photo of the day or a question that makes you think. Everything stays on your device. No account, no cloud.

WRITE THE WAY YOU LIKE
• Lined notebook editor with title and date
• Photos for every entry, from your gallery or the camera
• Mood of the day in five levels
• Tags to organize your entries
• Drafts are saved automatically as you type

NEVER A BLANK PAGE AGAIN
• A new question every day as a writing prompt
• Over 40 more questions to browse
• Templates for gratitude and an evening review

LOOK BACK
• “On this day”: what did you write a month or a year ago?
• Writing streak and longest streak
• Mood history of the last 30 days
• Calendar with mood colors and full-text search

STAY ON TRACK
• Daily reminder at the time you choose

PRIVATE AND SECURE
• All entries stay on your device only
• PIN lock, optionally with Face ID or fingerprint
• Back up to a file, restore on any device
• Trash: deleted entries can be restored for 30 days

FOUR STYLES
Paper, Minimal, Playful or Night – choose how your journal looks.

FREE WITH ADS
The app is free and shows ads. A one-time purchase removes them for good – no subscription. Your entries are never used for advertising.

Available in 14 languages.

today:
Today was one of those days you want to hold on to. We drove to the coast on a whim and watched the sun sink into the water.

What I’m grateful for: this moment, and that I didn’t miss it.
year: First day in the new flat
Boxes everywhere, but it already feels like home.
month: Live music under the open sky – goosebumps.
texts: An hour by the water after work. The air smelled of autumn and for a moment everything was completely still.
We talked about everything that’s on our minds. I’m so glad she’s in my life.
Far too many meetings. Tonight it’s just tea, a blanket and a good book.
Tried pumpkin soup with ginger – making that more often from now on.
The presentation went better than expected. Proud of myself!
Spent the whole afternoon reading and listening to music.
Grandma told stories from the old days again.
